entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
With a range of more than 34 kilometres, targeting warship-sized vessels at subsonic speed with a rocket engine, the Penguin is a stand-out missile for Royal New Zealand Navy flight crews on board SH-2G(I) Seasprite helicopters and Royal New Zealand Air Force armament technicians.
 
We operate guided missiles across our maritime, land and air domains. The anti-ship, anti-armour and anti-air capabilities are controlled by trained sailors, soldiers and aviators across the services.

Explore our missile systems ➡️ nzdf.mil.nz/missile-systems
